decision.observation: 3 mph, gear 1 after the full hold — slow, likely grinding. The car faces the green headland with two grey boulders two car lengths ahead, while the posted tarmac and a large blue puddle curve away to the right, pines on the right edge.
decision.hypothesis: The car is aimed at the boulders, not the lane. The route bends right past them, so a throttle-right hold should swing it onto the tarmac before it reaches the rocks.
decision.memory: Boulders ahead on this crest: do not use plain W again here — steer right to follow the lane around the headland.
